criteria.rationale: Within 180 days of the request, the patient was following a reduced-calorie diet and swimming or doing water aerobics about three times weekly. The July follow-up says to continue the plan, and the August visit documents ongoing diet and exercise efforts when Wegovy was requested.

The May 20 nutrition consult identifies itself as the first formal counseling and documents no prior structured diet or exercise plan; documented program follow-up extends only through August 10, less than six whole calendar months. The August report of eight months of diet and exercise efforts does not establish six months in a comprehensive program with continuing follow-up.

missing_requirements: At least six continuous months of documented participation in a comprehensive weight management program before drug therapy.
parsed.summary: Recent documentation supports continued reduced-calorie diet and increased activity alongside Wegovy. The documented comprehensive program began May 20, 2026, and does not meet the six-month duration requirement.
